notes: Tech-racingcars (Evoluzione, 1992): 1,995 cc, Garrett turbo with 38 mm restrictor, 1.9 bar maximum (absolute or gauge not stated), 330-365 hp at 7,000 rpm (330 hp = 246 kW used), 535 Nm at 4,000 rpm, 1,100 kg. Power CONFLICT: WRC.com (search excerpt) says 300 bhp; Wikipedia says Group A cars made far more than the notional 300 bhp, 'closer to 400'; the road Evoluzione is 210 PS at 5,750 rpm. Gearbox: the source lists three ratio sets (one 5-speed, two 6-speed) and many final drives, unpaired; the second 6-speed set with the 4.272 final drive listed for 1993 is used and may not match any one car. Tyres: Michelin 245/610-17 tarmac, 185/660-16 gravel (nominal width/overall diameter in mm, not parseable), so rearTyre is null. NOT FOUND: rev limit, idle, Cd, frontal area, a stated cylinder firing order (a Lampredi inline-four; the layout default 1-3-4-2 is assumed in the modelling).
